title: exam-tui exam
description: An exam for exam-tui. The app also checks rules a schema cannot express: "answer" must have exactly "select" keys, and every answer must be one of the question's option keys.

id.description: Unique id. Attempt history is grouped by it, so keep it the same when you edit the exam. A file with the same id as another exam replaces it.

title.description: Full title. The part before " — " is used as the short name in menus.

description.description: Optional text shown in the menu's Details panel.

time_limit_minutes.description: Time limit. Defaults to 120 minutes, as in the CCAR-F Exam Guide.

domains.description: Domains for the per-domain score breakdown, in display order. A question's domain that is not listed here is shown by its id.

weight.description: Optional: this domain's share of the real exam in percent (e.g. 27). When set, results also show a score estimate weighted by these shares.

number.description: Question number shown to the user. Must be unique within the exam.

scenario.description: Scenario or section heading shown above the question.

domain.description: Domain id, e.g. "D1". For several domains use "D4/1": the first one is used for scoring.

select.description: How many options the user must pick. Must be fewer than the number of options.

key.description: Capital letter for the option. Use unique keys, usually A, B, C, D in order.

answer.description: Keys of the correct options. Must contain exactly "select" keys.

why.description: Explanation shown when reviewing the question.
